I replied to Pree in our DM, in a thread on her message. I found three Marrow Fieldworks ticket numbers and one that might also belong to the account:

1. #4409: the Gatehouse Check-In report keeps timing out at the Salina North yard. It's in Moss's digest "Central handoffs next week" from 2 Jan 2026.
2. #4412: a driver SMS prompt glitch when staging combine trailers. It's in the same Moss digest.
3. PD-5302: a follow-up ticket from this week. Hollis posted it in #central-random on 14 Oct.

The possible one is #8841, a double-booking problem at West yard Door 2. Tobias flagged it in #central-random on 13 Oct, but nobody named the account; Hollis only called it "Tobias's dealer account". Moss's digest says Marrow Fieldworks changed hands in January, so it could be this account. I told Pree to check with Tobias or Hollis before counting it.

I left out FR-882 and PD-4821 because they belong to Marrow Agrisupply, a different account. Moss's other notes have no Marrow Fieldworks tickets. No other channel Pree belongs to had any posts this week, so I had nothing more to add for "this week's chat".

I only used sources Pree can see herself: Moss's public notes plus the channels she's in. Nothing needed approval.
